title: Improved bounded-error success probability
statement: Let $E$ be a verifier model closed under majority amplification. If a language $L$ is decidable using $E$ with success probability at least $2/3$ on every input, then it is decidable using $E$ with success probability at least $23/24$ on every input.
hypotheses_covered: A verifier model $E$ closed under majority amplification
A language $L$ in the bounded-error class with success probability at least $2/3$
